title: Swipe the years, and stickers that stay put
notes: Swipe the years left or right to see more of them; the months fill the strip with no arrows.
Stickers: tap one to pick it up, then two fingers anywhere on the screen to size and turn it. Tap off it twice to put it down.
Add photos or videos is in the menu (tap ArcMe).
No more backgrounds to choose — the page fills the screen on its own paper.
